summary: 发票税额资格确认与跨 owner 编排（复用 PH-252）on BASE 20ffc12. Does not reimplement invoice record/tax split/reversal: those stay in PH-252. Adds invoicing/migrations/0002_tax_qualification_guard.py which replaces only the TaxQualification append-only guard with vendor-aware SQLite/PG rules allowing pending->confirmed (recoverable/not_recoverable, decided_on/evidence/version change) and confirmed->superseded (status/version only), while keeping source_ref/tax_cents/created_at immutable and DELETE forbidden. Adds services: open_tax_qualification (pending fact for an existing invoice/line/allocation/reversal source, tax <= source tax), confirm_tax_qualification (owner/finance, company lock, request_token/expected_version, period/lock checks, evidence, plugin audit, no ledger/cost/revenue/cash writes), supersede_tax_qualification (old confirmed->superseded plus appended replacement confirmed fact preserving history), and link_invoice_orchestration (validates invoice/reversal ownership and the referenced owner fact for management-revenue reversal / cash refund / bank return / settlement adjustment incl. settlement/clearance/open-item refs; records the append-only reference chain in AuditEvent with plugin action, does not mutate other owners and does not claim a global single transaction). Adds read-only invoice_tax_snapshot/list with qualification history, effective qualification, orchestration reference chain and frozen issues (tax_qualification_missing/pending/superseded, orchestration_ref_missing, not_recoverable_costing_review_required); missing is null+missing, never zero. Adds invoicing/invoice_tax.html plus invoice-tax history_read page and invoice-tax-confirm/link business_write routes (owner/finance write, auditor read, member denied, disabled-module history read). No new canonical topic/command, no contract schema or applied-migration edits, no other-owner writes. Tests: 8 scoped (4 service incl. append-only/DB trigger probes, supersede, permissions/period, orchestration chain after reversal; 3 HTTP; plus existing PH-252 invoice suite). Actual runs: check ok/task_count=263; manage.py check exit0; makemigrations no changes; fresh SQLite verify ok; scoped 8 OK; full 1169/140.002s with only the known 8 macOS baseline failures. Deviations: PM project-level summary is impossible because Invoice has no project FK, so PM is denied detail/list (disclosed); orchestration is reference recording/validation only (owner writes must be performed first by the corresponding named owner service; invoicing does not invoke them), so no false single-transaction claim; no tax/orchestration verifier branch because core verify_integrity is outside the PH-320 allowlist (fresh DB passes; trigger probes included in tests); models.py unchanged. Reviewer round-1 blockers fixed: (1) link_invoice_orchestration now requires a matching InvoiceReversal for all cross-owner link kinds, validates the declared namespace/kind of each owner ref, derives the invoice project/counterparty source set from its allocations, and checks the referenced owner fact project/source and counterparty against that set (revenue adjustment, settlement/clearance/open-item and cash-refund/bank-return counterparty); cross-project/foreign and missing-reversal cases reject with zero writes, with regressions. (2) TaxQualification INSERT is now guarded by vendor-aware triggers requiring status pending, qualification_status unknown, decided_on NULL and version 1; supersede now appends a pending row then transitions it, so no direct confirmed/superseded insert is possible; a direct-insert probe covers this. (3) confirm_tax_qualification appends the confirmation evidence to the pending evidence instead of overwriting it, and supersede keeps the old evidence in the superseded row/replacement; tests assert the open evidence survives. The earlier PH-252 reuse/migration-only guard replacement/permissions/audit/no-ledger-write behaviour is unchanged.
